note: Written after M8's 30 planned servers ran and before any control server was timed (a startup check of the four controls timed nothing). The planned results showed FP8 KV and speculative decoding losing to either alone at one user, and vLLM's startup log said why it might: on this GPU FlashInfer can capture a full CUDA graph only for single-token decodes, so with speculation vLLM falls back to piecewise graphs. The controls separate three possible causes: the FP8 bytes, the piecewise graphs, and FlashInfer's own multi-token path. Letters as in m8.json, plus f = FlashInfer on a BF16 cache and g = piecewise CUDA graphs only. Qwen3-1.7B, output tokens/s ratios.
